about_the_game:
Use a variety of mechanical weapons and magical spells to defeat enemies in a dying world stuck in endless looped time in this 2.5 D Action Roguelite game.

Fight through hordes of enemies with a variety of mechanical weapon of your choice. Combine two weapon to create your desired combos. Fight, Learn, and make the best build you can

Pick from the dozens of unique spells in the game to combo with your weapon. Break the enemies stance and unleash your magical potential from gaining flow from stance break. From simple attack spells, to status effects, and debuffs.

Imbue your weapons with blessing to optimize your run. But be careful! Every blessing comes with curses that you would need to find a way to live with or get rid of.

And become even more powerful with the large variety of relics in your disposal. Pick up these items lost in time to truly get powerful passive skills to help your run
